propositions: test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote fails deterministically with exit 128 when git safe.bareRepository is set to explicit via environment injection

The _git() helper in test_ref_lock.py uses implicit bare repository discovery (git -C <bare.git>) which is refused under safe.bareRepository=explicit policy, but the push succeeds and the object is present in the remote
Prior art in _git_upkeep.py and test_concurrency_regression.py uses explicit git --git-dir naming for bare repositories to remain compatible with the safe.bareRepository=explicit policy
The test must pass under both safe.bareRepository=explicit policy and default policy to meet the portability contract established by test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py
Fixing test_ref_lock.py to use git --git-dir for bare repository operations instead of git -C makes the test portable across environments without product code changes
